text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the race. Lucky Lilac has maintained
complete silence since entering the waiting room.
If she's just focusing, that's fine, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It might be best to throw in something funny here to build up some momentum.
choice_data_list: Um... The customer next to us keeps—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm already all set, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"You think I'm still dwelling on that last loss?
Quite the opposite, actually."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'll never let anyone see me look that pathetic again.
That's why I was figuring out the winning path in my head the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: So with that, just sit back and watch with peace of mind.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'll take that unfinished gag as my celebration gift.
I'll be lookin' forward to hearin' just how funny it's gonna be.
